finalText:
**Build passes clean now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- `resolveRetries` in [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed the field name.
- `isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined`, since the new config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

Ran `node build.js`: exits 0, ends with `8 warnings, 0 errors`. The remaining 8 are deprecation/style noise from the bumped packages, not build breakers.
